lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a lattice-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of well-defined anchor nodes that define the shark's characteristic grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least three commensal fish (Remora sp.) swimming ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin, appearing as elongated dark silhouettes with high-luminance ventral edges.
